description_en: Retrieves the Codeup enterprise information based on the enterprise identifier (Yunxiao enterprise ID or enterprise path)
description_zh: 根据企业标识（云效企业ID或者企业路径）获取Codeup侧的企业信息
name: GetCodeupOrganization

parameters.help_en: The enterprise identifier, also known as the enterprise ID or enterprise path. This parameter is a string and can be obtained from the Yunxiao URL, such as https://devops.aliyun.com/organization/[OrganizationId]
parameters.help_zh: 企业标识，也称企业ID或企业路径，字符串形式，可在云效访问链接中获取，如https://devops.aliyun.com/organization/【OrganizationId】
parameters.name: identity

parameters.help_en: The personal access token. This parameter is not required if you use an Alibaba Cloud AccessKey pair or Security Token Service (STS) for temporary authorization
parameters.help_zh:
个人访问令牌。
使用阿里云AK+SK或使用STS临时授权方式不需要传该字段
parameters.name: access_token

createdAt.description_en: The creation time in the YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss format
createdAt.description_zh: 创建时间，格式为 YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss

namespaceId.description_en: The ID of the group or enterprise workspace to which the repository belongs
namespaceId.description_zh: 库所属组或者企业空间ID

organizationId.description_en: The enterprise identifier, also known as the enterprise ID. This parameter is a string and can be obtained from the Yunxiao URL, such as https://devops.aliyun.com/organization/[OrganizationId]
organizationId.description_zh: 企业标识，也称企业ID，字符串形式，可在云效访问链接中获取，如https://devops.aliyun.com/organization/【OrganizationId】

path.description_en: The path of the code repository

updatedAt.description_en: The update time in the YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss format
updatedAt.description_zh: 更新时间，格式为 YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss

userRole.description_en:
The role of the user in the enterprise. Valid values: 
ORG_MEMBER: member in the enterprise
ORG_ADMIN: enterprise administrator
ORG_OWNER: enterprise owner
ORG_EXTERNAL_MEMBER: external member of the enterprise
NO_ACCESS: no permissions
ADMIN: super administrator
userRole.description_zh:
用户在企业中的角色 
ORG_MEMBER：企业内成员
ORG_ADMIN：企业管理员
ORG_OWNER：企业拥有者
ORG_EXTERNAL_MEMBER：企业外部成员
NO_ACCESS：无权限
ADMIN：超级管理员

success.description_en: Indicates whether the call was successful
